# Map reference

`ethiopia_adm1_hdx_2025.geojson` is the frozen ADM1 geometry used for the report's locator map. It contains public administrative boundaries, not survey observations or estimates. Its properties identify COD-AB version v04 and a validity date of 2025-01-01. The 14 feature names are checked against the survey regions before plotting.

Source: [Ethiopia subnational administrative boundaries, HDX](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-eth), maintained by OCHA with underlying national administrative-boundary information. Preserve this attribution and consult the source dataset's reuse terms. A frozen copy ensures that future boundary revisions do not change this report's map.
